api_db.title: API + Database
api_db.intro: Use Microsoft Graph OAuth app credentials stored in database.

steps.title: Create Azure app registration
paragraphs: Create a Web app and add the redirect URI shown on this form as the app's Authorized Redirect URI.

steps.title: Grant API permissions and create a secret
paragraphs: Add Mail.Send, offline_access, and User.Read (Delegated), then create a client secret and copy its value.

steps.title: Enter tenant/client credentials
paragraphs: Use API mode + Database storage and fill Tenant ID, Client ID, Client Secret.

api_wp_config.title: API + wp-config.php
api_wp_config.intro: Store Azure app credentials in wp-config.php constants.

steps.title: Add constants
paragraphs: Copy generated constants and place them in wp-config.php.

steps.title: Verify and authorize
paragraphs: In WP Config mode, verify credentials and run OAuth authorization.

app_permission_db.title: Application Permission + Database
app_permission_db.intro: Send as any mailbox on your Microsoft 365 tenant using one Azure app credential and a single admin consent (Pro).

steps.title: Grant the Mail.Send Application permission
paragraphs: On your Azure app registration, add the Mail.Send permission under API permissions -> Application permissions (not Delegated), then click Grant admin consent.

steps.title: Enter application credentials
paragraphs: Select Application Permission mode, then fill Tenant ID (your real tenant GUID -- common does not work here), Application (client) ID, and Client Secret.

steps.title: Scope which mailboxes it can send as
paragraphs: Have your Exchange administrator run New-ManagementRoleAssignment to restrict this credential to specific mailboxes via RBAC for Applications, then set From Email to the mailbox to send as and save.

app_permission_wp_config.title: Application Permission + wp-config.php
app_permission_wp_config.intro: Store the application credential in wp-config.php constants instead of the database.

steps.title: Add constants
paragraphs: Copy generated constants (BOOLEANSMTP_OUTLOOK_APP_CLIENT_ID, _APP_CLIENT_SECRET, _APP_TENANT_ID) and place them in wp-config.php.

steps.title: Save and test
paragraphs: Set From Email to the mailbox to send as, save the connection, and send a test email.

one_click_db.title: API (One Click) + Database
one_click_db.intro: Use the hosted BooleanSMTP OAuth proxy for a fast Microsoft connection without manual Azure app setup.

steps.title: Select API (One Click)
paragraphs: Choose API (One Click) mode and keep Credential Storage as Database.

steps.title: Connect with Microsoft
paragraphs: Click Connect with Microsoft and complete consent in the hosted One Click flow.

steps.title: Save and test
paragraphs: Save connection after token status shows connected, then send a test email.

one_click_wp_config.title: API (One Click) + External Config
one_click_wp_config.intro: One Click token storage remains encrypted in database; external credential mode can still be used for sender settings.

steps.title: Connect first
paragraphs: Use Connect with Microsoft to complete One Click OAuth and store bearer token.

steps.title: Confirm settings and save
paragraphs: Save the connection and verify a test email. If One Click send fails, reconnect; SMTP fallback is not automatic in this mode.
